steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Conflict of the Orders (494-287 BC) was the struggle between patricians and plebeians for political equality

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The First Secession (494 BC): plebeians withdrew to the Sacred Mount, forcing the patricians to create the tribunes of the plebs

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Twelve Tables (451-450 BC): Rome's first written law code, created because plebeians were being judged by unwritten patrician customs

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Licinian-Sextian Laws (367 BC) required one consul to be a plebeian; the office was opened to plebeians
